ModMetaData.name: Lockjaw Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces sarg.alphaanimals's `AA_Lockjaw` art (mud-brown `AA_Lockjaw3` alternate texture set only — see scope note below) with custom generated art per the owner ruling in design/Jawa/worldbuilding/review/round2/decisions_propagated.json (`fauna:the_miasma:AA_Lockjaw`, `"art": "improve"` — *"Make it like a huge whale with alligator-like skin sitting and staring... then SNAP."*). LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_Lockjaw/AA_Lockjaw3_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
SCOPE, 2026-09-11 (LOCKJAW_ART_WIRE_IN_1): `AA_Lockjaw`'s PawnKindDef rolls one of THREE alternate texture sets per spawn (`AA_Lockjaw` bare, `AA_Lockjaw2` grey, `AA_Lockjaw3` brown), each a full south/east/north set. This mod ships `AA_Lockjaw3` (brown) complete and consistent across all three facings — east validated 2026-09-10, south+north validated 2026-09-11. `AA_Lockjaw2` (grey) is DEFERRED and deliberately left entirely on donor art: its east and north facings are already generated and validated, but its south facing failed the offline validator 5 times running (consistently ~20-90% too wide against the reference's narrow front-on silhouette, even after the prompt was rewritten to state the target aspect explicitly) and was not force-shipped rather than leave that one variant visibly inconsistent between rotations. The bare `AA_Lockjaw` variant was never in scope for this item and is untouched.
